precision_checks.conversion: Input guard accepts signed zero and BF16 biased exponents 113 through 142 inclusive. All 65,536 BF16 bit patterns were checked in both positions of packed register pairs. A nonrepresentable value in any lane selects scalar fallback for the whole group.
precision_checks.accumulation: FP32 accumulation order changes on the Volta Tensor Core path; a different greedy token can result. The emitted inputs to the FP16 products are exact.
precision_checks.blackwell_archived: All 60 archived test warps selected fallback; all 7,680 outputs were bitwise-identical to the VF scalar path. Both VF modes differed from the archived reference in 1,117 elements with the existing scalar accumulation order. These vectors do not exercise the guarded Tensor Core path.
